units.source_text: 老太婆讲了这番话，我无言以对，在地炉边上一味把脑袋耷拉下来。

en.t: After the old woman said this, I had no answer and just hung my head beside the hearth.

units.source_text: 越过山岭的汽车，震动着房子。

en.t: Cars crossing the mountain pass shook the house.

units.source_text: 我落入沉思：秋天都这么冷了，过不多久白雪将铺满山头，这位老大爷为什么不下山呢？

en.t: I sank into thought: if it was already this cold in autumn, and before long white snow would cover the mountains, why did this old man not go down from the mountain?

units.source_text: 我的衣衫升腾起一股水蒸气，炉火旺盛，烤得我头昏脑涨。

en.t: Steam rose from my clothes, and the blazing fire made my head feel heavy and dazed.

units.source_text: 老太婆在店堂同巡回演出的女艺人攀谈起来。

en.t: The old woman began chatting in the shop room with the traveling female performer.
